_meta.what_this_is: A sequence of tool-call ATTEMPTS a harness sent to a charging service. When a call succeeds but its acknowledgement is lost on the way back, the harness times out and RETRIES the same logical operation -- so some operations appear twice in the stream. Each attempt carries a client-supplied idempotency key that is stable across retries of the same operation and distinct across different operations. Two genuinely separate operations can charge the same amount; they still get different keys.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The attempt stream, the keys, and which attempts are retries are hand-authored so the double-apply (no dedup) and the drop-a-real-charge (dedup on content instead of the key) are exact and checkable; every applied total is computed in idempotency.py. true_total is the sum over DISTINCT keys.
_meta.format: attempts: [{key, op, amount, note}] in arrival order. key is the idempotency key; a repeated key is a retry of the same operation.

attempts.note: retry -- the ack for k1 was lost
a genuinely separate charge, same amount, different key
